gtm.title: GTM — Galaxy Training Manager
gtm.tagline: Operational Information System & decision engine (Flask, 3NF MySQL, real-time KPIs, and PCA module).
gtm.summary: Enterprise data application developed at Galaxy Solutions to centralize B2B training operations, automate decision KPIs, and ensure data integrity. Validated by 166 Pytest tests.

olist.title: E-Commerce Data Pipeline & Audit — Olist
olist.tagline: Final analysis dataset: 96,252 orders from a Brazilian marketplace.
olist.summary: Data ingestion and audit pipeline across 9 relational tables: temporal anomaly resolution, zero-loss joins, delivery delay impact on satisfaction, and seller risk scoring.

afc.title: Correspondence Analysis (CA) from Scratch
afc.tagline: Pure mathematical implementation in Python (NumPy/SciPy) & skill mapping.
afc.summary: CA algorithm implemented from scratch across 8 matrix steps: contingency table, standardized residuals, SVD diagonalization, 2D biplot, and validation on 25,955 LinkedIn job mentions.

acp.title: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
acp.tagline: Multivariate analysis of 169 countries and 9 socio-economic indicators in Python.
acp.summary: Individual factorial analysis project in Python (Pandas/NumPy): feature standardization, spectral diagonalization, correlation circles, and factorial projection explaining 63.86% of total inertia.

revision-flow.title: RevisionFlow
revision-flow.tagline: Smart study revision planner, 100% in-browser, with real-time recalculation.
revision-flow.summary: Study planning web application featuring real-time rescheduling algorithms, workload overflow detection (backlog), audio Pomodoro timer, and local browser persistence.

sante-scolaire.title: SantéScolaire
sante-scolaire.tagline: School health tracking web application with role-based access (Flask & MySQL).
sante-scolaire.summary: An application for managing student records, visits, appointments, prescriptions, stock, and activity indicators.

novastore.title: NovaStore
novastore.tagline: An online-store prototype built by a team of five.
novastore.summary: Product list, cart, and printable invoice. My main contribution was designing and implementing the app; payment is simulated.

pneumonia-detection.title: Pneumonia Detection from Chest X-rays — Deep Learning
pneumonia-detection.tagline: Team academic project comparing a custom CNN with DenseNet121 transfer learning.
pneumonia-detection.summary: NORMAL / PNEUMONIA classification on 5,856 chest X-rays, with reported metrics and source discrepancies documented.

goodthought-sql-analysis.title: SQL Analysis of Donations and Impact — GoodThought
goodthought-sql-analysis.tagline: Guided DataCamp project exploring donations and impact scores by assignment and region.
goodthought-sql-analysis.summary: SQL queries on assignments, donations, and donors in a practice case, using aggregations, CTEs, and regional rankings.

motorcycle-parts-sales.title: Motorcycle Parts Sales Analysis
motorcycle-parts-sales.tagline: Guided DataCamp project analysing wholesale sales by product, month, and warehouse.
motorcycle-parts-sales.summary: SQL queries on 1,000 practice orders, grouped by product line, month, and warehouse.

students-mental-health.title: Analyzing Students’ Mental Health
students-mental-health.tagline: Guided DataCamp project comparing scores by student status and length of stay.
students-mental-health.summary: SQL analysis of PHQ-9, SCS, and ASISS scores in a survey of students in Japan.

grocery-store-sales.title: FoodYum Grocery Store Sales SQL Analysis
grocery-store-sales.tagline: Official DataCamp practical exam: data integrity audit, advanced SQL cleaning, and sales targeting.
grocery-store-sales.summary: Official DataCamp practical exam (Data Analyst Associate) in PostgreSQL: integrity bug audit, CTE and median-based cleaning (PERCENTILE_CONT), and strategic sales targeting.

about.title: About
about.intro: I am a second-year engineering student in Computer Science and Data Engineering at ENSA Khouribga. Through my projects, I have prepared and analysed data, applied statistical methods, and developed web applications. My primary field is Data Analytics & BI, with an Analytics Engineering orientation.
about.search: I am seeking a Data Analytics & BI PFA internship starting in July 2027, with a particular interest in Analytics Engineering: SQL modelling, data quality, and data preparation for analysis. I also remain open to Data Engineering opportunities. Holding the official <certLink>DataCamp Data Analyst Associate</certLink> certification and the <trackLink>Associate Data Analyst in SQL</trackLink> track, I leverage my annual access to deepen PostgreSQL modelling and data pipelines.

about.galaxyText: During this introductory internship, I designed and developed a training management and tracking application. I modeled the relational database (MySQL in 3NF), implemented the application logic with Flask, and built an executive KPI dashboard featuring a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) module. The demonstration uses fictional data.
about.cestomText: I help coordinate the Khouribga section, welcome new Togolese students, and support members. I also relay information to the national office and help organise cultural, scientific, and sports activities.
